barcodeModal.title: Import a Disk
barcodeModal.subtitleBarcode: Enter the EAN/UPC number from the sleeve — pre-population via {{sources}}.
barcodeModal.subtitleQuery: Album title, “artist title” or EAN/UPC number — strict cascade: 1. Last.fm → 2. Discogs → 3. MusicBrainz (active sources: {{sources}}).
barcodeModal.errorInvalidBarcode: The barcode must contain between 8 and 14 digits (EAN/UPC).
barcodeModal.queryPlaceholder: E.g. Pink Floyd — The Dark Side of the Moon (or an EAN number)…
barcodeModal.minCharsError: Enter at least 2 characters: album title, “artist title”, or an EAN/UPC number.
barcodeModal.queryHint: Usable when the barcode fails: album title, “artist title” or EAN number — forced search order: Last.fm first (sleeves), then Discogs, then MusicBrainz.
barcodeModal.noResults: No disk found for this search — try broadening your request (title only, “artist title”, or the exact EAN number of the album).
barcodeModal.noTracklist: No track list returned: to be filled in manually
barcodeModal.importNote: EAN/UPC number: 8 to 14 digits — the sheet is pre-populated before saving.

isbnModal.title: Fill via ISBN / Barcode
isbnModal.subtitle: Enter the comic's ISBN, OR — if its barcode fails — find it by KEYWORDS (title, author, series) via Google Books + Open Library.
isbnModal.errorInvalidIsbn: ISBN expected: 13 digits (ISBN-13) or 10 characters (ISBN-10, last X allowed).
isbnModal.queryPlaceholder: E.g. Les Démons d'Alexia — Le sang de l'ange (or an author, a series)…
isbnModal.minCharsError: Enter at least 2 characters: comic title, author, series…
isbnModal.queryHint: Usable when the ISBN / barcode fails: comic title, author, series… (queries Google Books “q=…”).
isbnModal.noResults: No book found for this search — try broadening your request (title only, author only, or the title “without” the subtitle).
